notes.title: ver3.00.05
notes.content: - Adjustment of the internal processing order of the result screen as a countermeasure against errors.

notes.title: ver3.00.04
notes.content:
- Fixed a typographical error.

- When deleting saved data, it was confirmed that corrupt files could occur
  due to failure to destroy files.

  Since a corrupted file makes it impossible to open “Load” and progress will not be possible,
  we added a process to delete the corrupted file along with the dialog in such cases.

notes.title: ver3.00.00
notes.content:
- Resource management and other optimizations have been made to support the Nintendo Switch.
- Fixed a bug that fast-forwarding is only released during loading.
- Fixed a bug that some enemies' body attacks were not accelerated by fast-forwarding.
- Fixed Saturn Buster.

notes.title: ver2.00.01
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that prevented the “Quick Knife” skill from working. 
- Fixed a bug that prevented the effect total display window from disappearing.

notes.title: ver2.00.00
notes.content: - English is now supported.

notes.title: ver1.03.04
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that caused the screen to go out on Lade's attacks 
- Fixed event text, etc. 
- Fixed other bugs.

notes.title: ver1.03.03
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that prevented the ending screen from opening.

notes.title: ver1.03.02
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem with the mouse option operation. 
- Fixed a problem with the conditions for some events to occur.

notes.title: ver1.03.01
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where unfulfilled EDs could be seen when checking endings.
- Corrected a mistake in the description of some items.

notes.title: ver1.03.00
notes.content:
- A difficulty level “Saveable” has been added after clearing.
- Added an item to the bookstore after clearing the game to make it easier to capture the ending.
- It is now possible to view the achieved EDs again on the ending screen.
- The ending confirmation screen now displays achievement hints even for endings that have already been completed.
- Added On/Off setting for skip effects.
- Fixed a bug that could cause different saved data to disappear when deleting saves on the load screen.
- Changed drop items in some battles.

notes.title: ver1.02.07
notes.content:
- Some text corrections.
- Fixed a problem where some fixed defeat events could be won, so the balance has been adjusted and the event will progress even if the player wins.
- Fixed a bug where the skill to hold on to your strength at 1 sometimes did not work correctly.
- The electric knife technique has been revised downward.

notes.title: ver1.02.05
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug in which CALCAL stops in the movement motion at double speed.
- Fixed inconsistencies in the story depending on the timing of some events.

notes.title: ver1.02.04
notes.content: - Fixed a problem with Aurora going off-screen with her own attacks.

notes.title: ver1.02.03
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that skills cannot be scrolled by buttons on the parts change screen.
- Fixed a bug that the minus sign disappears on equipment with a minus weight.
- Fixed a bug that some enemy's skills are used repeatedly despite the number of times they have been used.

notes.title: ver1.02.02
notes.content: - Correction of typographical errors

notes.title: ver1.02.01
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug in some battle conversations that referred to flags that were not originally necessary.
- Fixed a random event in a mail order event.

notes.title: ver1.02.00
notes.content:
- Correction of typos.
- Implementation of an ending screen.
  Hints for cleared and uncleared endings can be checked.

notes.title: ver1.00.04
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused the progress to become impossible when using “Double Accel” with some equipment.

notes.title: ver1.00.03 Update
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused the game to become inoperable when playing a new game.
Fixed a bug that prevented some equipment from being displayed during events.
Fixed a typographical error in some texts.
